Interface GamePhaseHandler

All Superinterfaces:
GameCommandVisitor
All Known Implementing Classes:
ActionPhase, ColorChoosingPhase, EndOfGamePhase, EndOfRoundPhase, PlacementPhase, PreEndOfRoundPhase, SetupPhase
public interface GamePhaseHandler extends GameCommandVisitor
Defines the behavior of a game phase handler. This interface manages the logic and command processing for a specific game phase. It implements the visitor pattern to handle different types of game commands and ensures that only current phase related commands are processed during each phase.

      default void visit(ChooseColorCommand cmd) throws Exception
      Processes a color choice command. This default implementation throws an exception as color selection is not allowed in the current phase.

      Parameters:
      cmd - the color choice command to process
